name: bruin
description: Monitor, troubleshoot, and operate your Bruin data platform—from pipeline health and failed runs to backfills, alerts, and costs.

interface.longDescription: Monitor and operate your Bruin Cloud workspace from ChatGPT. Inspect pipelines, assets, runs, validation errors, and costs; trigger reruns and backfills; and manage notifications using the permissions of your connected Bruin account.
capabilities: Inspect pipeline and asset run history
Add notes and update run status
defaultPrompt: Show me the unhealthy assets in my Bruin workspace.
Show me the current validation errors in my Bruin workspace.

positive.description: List pipelines in the connected workspace
positive.prompt: List the first 10 pipelines in my Bruin workspace without including their assets.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 pipelines available to the connected account, including their project and status, without embedded asset details.

positive.prompt: List up to 20 current pipeline validation errors in my Bruin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 20 validation errors visible to the connected account and identify the affected projects, pipelines, or assets.

positive.prompt: List the connections configured in my Bruin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return connection names, types, and timestamps visible to the connected account without exposing any credential values.

positive.prompt: List the notification rules configured in my Bruin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the notification rules visible to the connected account, including their subscriptions, selectors, and deliveries.

positive.prompt: List the pipeline run tags available in my Bruin workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the distinct run tags visible to the connected account.

negative.description: User and role administration is unsupported, so the plugin should explain the limitation without calling a tool.
negative.prompt: Invite new-user@example.com to my Bruin workspace and make them an administrator.

negative.description: The plugin must not access workspaces or data outside the connected account's authorization.
negative.prompt: Show me pipelines from another company's Bruin workspace that I cannot access.

negative.description: Money transfers are outside the plugin's data-platform scope and no tool should be called.

review.commerce_description: Bruin does not sell products or process payments through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of the Bruin plugin with authenticated pipeline, asset, run, backfill, notification, validation, and cost-management tools.
